name: Translate pages
description: Firefox's private page translation: pages are translated on your computer, nothing is sent to a translation service. Breached asks when a page is in another language, or type :translate (:translate de for German, :translate off for the original). Each language downloads once from Mozilla, about 20 to 40 MB.

settings.label: Translate into
settings.hint: A language code like en, de or fr. Empty means the language Breached runs in.

settings.label: Offer to translate pages in other languages
